price_policy.source: Yahoo Finance public daily chart; saved historical reconstruction, not a snapshot captured in 2025
price_policy.completion: NYSE/Nasdaq regular daily session closed 16:00 America/New_York on 2025-08-04, before fixed cutoff 2025-08-05T00:00-04:00; later downloaded final daily OHLCV record, not a live today quote
price_policy.freshness: Reference policy v1: previous completed regular trading session at this fixed midnight cutoff; no earlier missing session accepted. Human review of historical session/completion and policy adequacy pending.
price_policy.basis: Common share quote basis compatible with filing diluted EPS, conditional on independently reviewing vendor split-event coverage. No split events returned from annual-EPS end through retrieval in the separately saved extended request; no FX/split adjustment performed.
price_policy.numeric_rule: Read raw JSON decimals using Decimal, preserve the full serialized close for P/E; show two decimal places only as a display aid. Do not use binary float authority.
